title: Quillen's conjecture in rational homology

result.label: Quillen's conjecture in rational homology
result.statement: Proves the rational-homology form of Quillen's conjecture for every finite group and every prime. If the largest normal p -subgroup of G is trivial, the poset of nontrivial elementary abelian p -subgroups has nonzero augmented reduced rational homology and is therefore not contractible.
